items.title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
items.summary: Attackers replaced legitimate transactions with fake ones, then waited for users to approve higher fees. At least one person lost bitcoin before developers patched the flaw.

items.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
items.summary: Ether and XRP led losses among the majors as the AI trade took another hit in Asia, where Goldman Sachs cut its Kospi target by 25%.

items.title: From Stripe to Bitcoin: Card Fraud Case Ends in Prison Sentence
items.summary: A Rochester man's fraud scheme moved unauthorized credit-card payments through bank accounts before funding bitcoin purchases and transfers to co-conspirators. Timothy Wadsworth received a prison sentence after processing hundreds of attempted charges using account numbers supplied by others. Unauthorized Card Payments Funded…

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.

items.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
items.summary: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

items.title: Bitcoin's wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
items.summary: Borrowing against bitcoin and earning income to build their BTC holdings are becoming priorities for long-term investors, Xapo Bank CEO Seamus Rocca told CoinDesk.
